--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,54 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
-
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
+                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
+                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
+    
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+    
+    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
+    
+    # Compute normalized weights
+    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
+    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
+    sum_weights = np.sum(raw_weights)
+    if sum_weights == 0:
+        normalized_weights = np.zeros_like(raw_weights)
+    else:
+        normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights
+    
+    # Compute losses: negative weighted log probability
+    L_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
+    L_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)
+    L_no = -np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)
+    
+    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
+    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no, L_call)
+    
+    # Margin
+    margin = L_minus - L_with
+    
+    # Keep
+    keep = margin >= tau_filter
+    
+    return keep, margin
